## Checklist

- [ ] The full local gate passes: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test`
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes (they run against a local bare repo — no secrets/network)
- [ ] Docs updated if configuration, tools, or behavior changed
- [ ] The change is focused (one logical change) and targets `main`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private project URLs in the diff or test fixtures
